description: Make a public ticket comment private in Zendesk. This action changes the visibility of a comment from public to internal-only, so only agents can view it. Use this action when you need to convert a customer-facing comment to an internal note after the fact. Note: Only agents can make comments private; end users cannot use this endpoint.

inputSchema.description: Request model for making a ticket comment private.

ticket_comment_id.description: ID of the ticket comment to make private.
ticket_comment_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the comment within the ticket. You can get this ID from the ticket's comment list.
ticket_comment_id.title: Ticket Comment Id

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket containing the comment to make private.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The Zendesk ticket ID that contains the comment you want to make private. Find this ID in the ticket URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
